selected_entries_recorded_in_registry.intermediary_note: The valued form line is the Ivanka M. Trump Business Trust holding. IT Collection LLC is the holding company named within that line and is recorded as the registry counterparty entity (cp_entity_0007). The Business Trust is the intermediary; per the Fork B single-relationship decision it is not modeled as a separate cp_entity this pass. The 'Over $50,000,000' value is the forcing case for the new value shape `floor` (see docs/methodology.md, 'Value shape: floor').
selected_entries_recorded_in_registry.value_vs_income_note: The registry stores the asset value bracket on the relationship's value object (shape=floor, floor=50000000) and the income-type/income-amount strings here in the filing payload. This matches the existing pattern (e.g. cp_rel_0009 income recorded in cp_filing_0003.interest_disclosed). The two brackets are not conflated: only the asset value is open-ended; the income amount ($1,000,001 - $5,000,000) is an ordinary bounded range.

The decision was written against an inaccurate model of the schema: it specs a new `derives_from_relationship_id` field and a `relationship_type` enum, but the registry already models imputed edges via Value.imputation_source + shape=imputed + interest_type=spousal_imputed (see cp_rel_0004, cp_rel_0007). It also misidentified cp_rel_0005/0006 as imputed-from-Jared edges; they are direct ownership edges. The Westminster spousal-imputed edge and the Ivanka OPO re-sourcing are held pending maintainer decision on whether to reuse the existing imputation_source mechanism or add the parallel field.

categories.rationale: Mortgages on the filer's primary personal residence; excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(i). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Loans secured by a personal motor vehicle, household furniture, or appliances (unless the loan exceeds the item's purchase price); excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(ii). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Credit card and revolving charge account balances under $10,000 outstanding to a single creditor at the end of the reporting period; excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(iii). No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).

Interpersonal loans from a spouse, parent, sibling, or child of the filer (natural-person counterparty only); excluded by 5 CFR 2634.308(b)(2)(iv). Does NOT apply to entity-mediated debt (e.g., loans from a family-controlled trust or LLC), which are written as normal debt_instrument_owed edges per Convention 5. No Part 8 rows on this filing fall into this bucket (per Fork F §2 transcription).
